alarm_storage: uint8 packbits along time axis, bitorder little; all 960 bits and all nine configurations per fault per repetition. No alarm latching or onset reset.
evaluation_order: rep01..rep05, F03,F09,F15, normal then faulty; include every registered configuration and failure
fault_pairing: One identity schedule per fault shared by all five fitted states and both members of its prespecified contrast. Average the five per-run differences BEFORE resampling for the three primary finite-five-state means. Never pool as 1250 independent runs.
normal_pairing: One identity schedule shared across all 135 local normal monitors; auxiliary FAR differences use the same paired identities. No bank-OR interpretation.
per_rep_intervals: marginal 95%, descriptive and conditional, not simultaneous across 15 comparisons
raw_scoring: Byte-identical Stage B project and selected_outcomes implementations; no fit, select_one, calibrate_one or simulator calls. Strict > retained.
stop_policy: stop dispatch before next repetition, finish current repetition; final aggregation can be resumed without rescoring committed repetitions
training_uncertainty: Five-fit mean/median/range/sign counts are descriptive; no population-training CI. Conditional paired intervals exclude new training/PCA uncertainty.
